title: int:Asset
description: Abstract base class for all energy devices in the INTELLIGENT platform. Subclass of saref:Device and cim:Equipment. Carries no measurement fields — measurements are expressed as sosa:Observation instances.

assetId.description: Unique identifier. IRI: int:assetId. Format: UUID v4.

assetType.description: Controlled device type enumeration. IRI: int:assetType.

isControllable.description: True if asset exposes an actuator interface. IRI: saref:isControllable.

nominalPower.description: Rated/nominal active power capacity in watts. IRI: cim:nominalP. Unit: W.

commissioningDate.description: Date asset was commissioned. IRI: cim:commissionedDate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

protocol.description: Communication protocol. IRI: int:communicationProtocol. Required when isControllable = true.

validFrom.description: Start of asset registration validity. IRI: int:validFrom. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of registration validity. NULL if still active. IRI: int:validUntil.

ownedBy.description: FK to owning Actor. IRI: int:ownedBy. UUID v4.

siteId.description: FK to Site (physical location). IRI: int:locatedAt. UUID v4.

facilityId.description: FK to Facility (building). IRI: int:installedAt. Nullable. UUID v4.
